blurb:
Step inside a vibrant, soulful celebration of Motown’s greatest legends — powerhouse vocals, smooth harmonies, iconic choreography, and the electrifying energy that shaped an era. The Original Motown Tribute Show brings the unforgettable sounds of The Temptations, Diana Ross & The Supremes, Marvin Gaye, Stevie Wonder, Smokey Robinson, and more to life in an intimate cabaret-style setting where every seat feels close to the experience.

During the holiday season, the stage shines even brighter with festive Motown cheer, featuring cherished classics like The Temptations’ “Silent Night” and Donny Hathaway’s “This Christmas.” The show features most of the timeless Motown hits you love with just a splash of holiday music.

A joyful, soulful night that keeps audiences singing, dancing, and smiling long after the final note.
